name: Optimal Delaunay Triangulation (ODT) Loss
definition: An energy metric $E_{	ext{ODT}}$ used to optimize mesh quality by minimizing the difference between the moment of inertia of a tetrahedron and its circumsphere.
summary: ODT loss is a mesh quality regularization term that penalizes tetrahedra for deviating from regular shapes by minimizing the difference between circumsphere and principal moments of inertia.
